data_points.notes: SCOPE CAVEAT: IMARC states scope = bath soaps, body wash, bath additives, others (bar soap IS included). Organised/unorganised coverage not stated by the source. CONFLICT: IMARC's own separate India bath soap page puts bath soap ALONE at USD 3,406.3mn (2025) — 1.9x this whole-category figure, which is internally impossible if bath soap sits inside bath & shower products. Both recorded as separate claims; definitional mismatch unresolved, do not average.

IMARC: USD 1.8bn (2025) to USD 2.5bn (2034), CAGR 3.80% 2026-2034. Organised/unorganised coverage not stated. cf IMARC bath-soap-only page 4.88% over the same 2026-2034 window — see the conflicting market_size pair on this segment.

SCOPE CAVEAT: bath soap only (solid + liquid bath soaps, premium + mass); excludes bath additives. Organised/unorganised coverage not stated, though the source references kirana outlets and local shops alongside organised retail. CONFLICT: cf IMARC india-bath-shower-products-market USD 1.8bn (2025) for the WIDER category that IMARC itself says contains bath soaps — 1.9x gap in the wrong direction, definitional mismatch unresolved, do not average.

SCOPE CAVEAT: bath soap only. IMARC: USD 3,406.3mn (2025) to USD 5,300.6mn (2034), CAGR 4.88% 2026-2034. Organised/unorganised coverage not stated. cf IMARC bath & shower products page 3.80% over the identical window.

SCOPE CAVEAT: bath soap only — beauty bars, baby soap, medicated soap, herbal soap and others; excludes body wash and bath additives. Organised/unorganised coverage not stated. Corroborates IMARC's bath-soap-only USD 3,406.3mn (2025) within ~4% and therefore reinforces that IMARC's wider 'bath & shower products' USD 1.8bn (2025) is the outlier, not the soap figures. Do not average across the two definitions.

SCOPE CAVEAT: bath soap only. "3.16% during the forecast period, i.e., 2025-30", USD 3.54bn (2024) to USD 4.22bn (2030). Organised/unorganised coverage not stated. cf IMARC bath-soap 4.88% (2026-2034) and IMARC bath & shower products 3.80% (2026-2034).
